title: Step 65-B Wholesale customer application/status and B2B authority contract readiness
description: HIGH-risk Step 65-B. Repair only the proven customer Wholesale HTTP/OpenAPI contract drift before Storefront implementation: explicit 201 submit status, typed customer-owned wholesale application response, typed nullable latest-application read, accurate auth/conflict/validation responses, and reproducible generated TypeScript. Freeze existing CustomerProfile customer_type and server-resolved CheckoutQuote customer_type as the only current B2B identity/pricing authorities. Do not change wholesale domain transitions, database, pricing rules, Cart/Checkout business logic, admin review authority or Storefront.

dependencies.evidence: PR #330 merged; exact-SHA Canonical CI 37529029137 and Phase A 37529029136 PASS; terminal Lock release comment 6025205025.

audit_findings: Runtime POST /customer/wholesale/applications is customer-only, idempotency-protected and returns the created application; Nest POST defaults to HTTP 201, while current OpenAPI advertises stale 200/202 with no response content.
Runtime GET /customer/wholesale/application is customer-only and returns the latest owned application or null; current OpenAPI 200 has no response content.
PostCustomerWholesaleApplicationsRequest is already typed with current runtime fields and limits.
CustomerWholesaleService owns eligibility and transitions; applicant remains retail until staff approval; no domain/service repair is required.
GlobalExceptionFilter maps CUSTOMER_REQUIRED to 401, validation/default DomainError to 422, and concurrency/constraint conflicts to 409.
CustomerProfileResponse already exposes authoritative customer_type retail|wholesale.
AuthSessionActor does not expose customer_type and is not expanded in this stage.
Cart Quote already resolves customer type server-side and CheckoutQuoteResponse exposes authoritative customer_type; pricing/Cart logic does not require mutation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Customer wholesale submit explicitly uses HTTP 201 and its OpenAPI response body is typed as the exact runtime-owned Wholesale application view; stale 200/202 success responses are removed.
Customer latest wholesale application GET is typed as Wholesale application-or-null, preserving the runtime no-application state without inventing a sentinel status.

Wholesale application view includes only current runtime-present fields with bounded/typed identifiers, nullable notes/timestamps/decision fields and status enum submitted|under_review|approved|rejected.

Customer wholesale submit/read contracts include current customer-session security and fail-closed 401 plus appropriate 409/422 error responses without exposing admin decision endpoints as customer authority.
Existing request body fields/limits remain aligned to CustomerWholesaleService input validation; no new eligibility, business type enum or document/upload requirement is invented.

CustomerProfileResponse remains the typed current customer_type presentation authority; AuthSessionActor is not expanded. CheckoutQuoteResponse and Cart runtime remain the server-resolved pricing/customer-type authority.
Generated TypeScript is byte-for-byte reproducible from canonical OpenAPI via openapi-typescript.
No database migration, dependency, Storefront, customer domain/application, Pricing, Cart/Checkout, admin authority, Product Design or Current-State mutation is introduced.

HIGH-risk terminal closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, CodeQL/Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, exact-artifact Project Owner Human approval, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Step 65-B is HIGH risk. Project Owner Human approval must bind to the frozen exact head/artifact only after provider checks, Security, deterministic Review and ACTIVE Lock pass.
